subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjectLayer
subsystem.responsibility: Session/game-data runtime object layer: loads and deserializes track/vehicle data files, owns the linked node lists and loading/phase state, drives the two-phase session loading sequence, walks replay node lists, and provides supporting lap-timing, scene-extent, replay-recording, dispatcher, and standings-writer objects. Shared runtime state is carried through process globals (vehicle pointer array, session type, session phase, session time).

summary: Reconstruction of the generic runtime object layer. The dominant object, SessionDataObject, loads/resets game data files (GameDataFileIO), deserializes binary model/scene streams (ModelSceneFileLoader), walks its third linked node list to dispatch byte ranges (NetworkBufferRead), and drives the two-phase session loading sequence (LoadingPhase1, runLoadingPhase2, ProcessDriverEntries, LoadingPhaseOrchestrator). Supporting objects: ReplayRecordingController wraps a SessionDataObject to start/poll replay recording; SessionWeatherDispatcher routes by a type sentinel to session or weather update; LapTimingObject handles per-driver lap/sector completion; SceneExtentObject computes normalized scene extents; LapSessionDataObject is a constructor-style initializer; SettingsIniWriterObject emits a career standings ini block; SceneNodeWriter emits model node records. All ownership is UNKNOWN in the packet and this proposal is DERIVED/GUESS only.

function_roles.role: Model/scene node record writer: resolves a resource handle via ResourceLookupDispatcher into this+0x04, then writes the object through FileWriteWithBackendDispatch as 4 dword-bytes then 2 dword-bytes; always returns 1. Consumed by ModelSceneFileLoader's third-list rebuild.

Binary model/scene file deserializer on the session data object: reads string tables and byte flags into this+0xF1C/0xF20, rebuilds the first list (this+0x18 block, count this+0x40, pool this+0x38), tears down and rebuilds the second list (this+0x6C0..0x6CC) from stream nodes, reads three dwords into this+0xF24/0xF28/0xF2C, transfers linked buffers, rebuilds the third list (this+0x714..0x720) via SceneNodeWriter (0x004B44A0), consumes per-node format headers, and computes bounding extents into this+0xF30/0xF34; returns 1 on success.

Loads or resets game data files for a track/vehicle on the session data object: with the cleanup flag (a3 nonzero) it frees the node list at this+0x6C0, zeroes list state, rebuilds directory/name path strings from dword_7CE5D0 / dword_7CE608 (backslash scan), re-reads vehicle field +18580 into this+0xF1C and session type into this+0xF20, and stores 1/0 in this+0x700 per settings-file presence; with the flag clear it opens an audio stream, loads the model/scene file via ModelSceneFileLoader, stores 2 in this+0x700 on success, and closes the handle on failure. Returns *(this+0x6E4) != 0.

Walks a linked list of data entries (list head this+0x714, walk pointer this+0x71C), selects entries whose float key lands in [a4, a5], seeks the resource to the entry payload offset via sub_566DB0, and dispatches the byte delta in 1024-byte chunks through FileWriteWithBackendDispatch plus ConditionalDispatch_6bd0, accumulating the total. Falls back to FileSizeQueryWithFallback + ResourceLookupDispatcher when the walk ends. Returns the total bytes dispatched, or 0 when the list head or its first entry is empty.

First phase of session loading on the session data object: pops the session queue, early-returns 0 when the range width (this+0xF34 minus this+0xF30) is not positive, resolves a loading resource into this+0xF40, iterates the vehicle array (dword_7C54F0, count dword_5C329C) initializing per-vehicle effect tables and state/visibility bytes (this+0x734 / this+0x93C), transitions the session state to 3, sets clamp mode this+0xF81, marks the loading-phase flag this+0xF80, and runs state-trigger checks in a loop bounded by a 0.75 accumulator; returns 1 on success.

Second phase of session loading on the session data object: sets this+0xF80 to 1, runs SafeDivisionWithZeroGuard over flt_5EA4E8 with a 0.75*1.5 threshold and a StateTriggerCheck loop accumulating dbl_8AFE90, applies AngleClampWrap with dbl_8AFEA0, sets clamp mode this+0xF81 to 0 (wrap), and when the vehicle count is positive iterates dword_7C54F0 driving SessionStateTransition over this+0x734, UIElementIterateUpdate, visibility propagation (this+0x93C), MultiObjectRemove and SetDriverVisibility. Then cleans the session structure (dword_5EA560), calls GuardedVirtualCall, releases the resource handle this+0xF40 via sub_566DB0, sets it to -1, and returns 1.

Driver/vehicle entry loader on the session data object: iterates the vehicle entry array from unk_5EC6D8 (stride 4656) to the byte_7C54D8 end sentinel, walks each entry's linked list (head this+0x40, cursor this+0x48) matching the float key this+0xF38, copies name/path strings from the matched node, and when the path is new loads the vehicle-generation scene, transitions session state and adjusts dword_5C329C; empty previously-active entries are deactivated; finally updates the driver name via SetDriverName. Returns the one-past-end entry pointer.

Session loading orchestrator: when the disable flag byte_7CE254 is clear, forces the session-type global dword_7C569C to 1, decodes the phase, runs LoadingPhase1, clamps the time offset to [10.0, 180.0], polls the key-priority chain while advancing the game state machine, sets the player vehicle index, runs LoadingPhase2, restores the session type, and returns a dispatcher result via ArithmeticComparison_8d60 or ShortComputation_8d70; stores the incoming time into the object at +0xF84 and the delegation result into +0xF88.

Replay recording controller: when the session state allows it and (dword_7D0038 || dword_7D005C) with session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, creates the replay directory, reads the track name, builds the replay file path, starts the recorder sub-struct (this+0x08) via ThunkToFUN004b7300 (GameDataFileIO), and drives/polls it with SingleFunctionDispatch_9800 / SingleFunctionCallWrapper_9860; state 2 sets a flag byte on the recorder sub-struct. Otherwise shows a 'recording not available' message via TextLineWrappingAndRendering. Invoked by Game_Restart (0x0042D7A0).

Type-sentinel two-path dispatcher: reads the sentinel at this[0]; value 1 runs the session update path (a ring-buffer/session wrapper via CallWrapper_9870 on this+0x08, a session-state check, and an optional scoring/state update via sub_4B9890); value 2 runs the weather path (a packed-flag read via PackedFlagRead_9a00 gated by a second update call). Returns a char status from whichever path ran.

Session lap/sector completion handler on the per-driver lap-timing object: early-returns when the session is finished (obj+0x32C8 == 3). On the full-lap path (a4 == 0) records the lap split into the per-lap array, updates best-lap/best-sector state and the pit-stop order rank, dispatches on dword_7C56A4 (retirement, penalty/stop-go, disqualification, finish, last-lap menus), runs a pending-penalty countdown, and writes the common tail (last time, lap-time array, phase flag). On the sector path updates per-sector bests and flags.

Scene extent computation: walks the collision geometry node list (count from AudioNetworkNodeCount(dword_8AFE88)), folds per-node bounding boxes (BoundingBoxComputation) into min/max accumulators, and on the degenerate/empty path emits the 'could not get extent' debug log; otherwise stores this[585]/this[587] as scene minima and this[586]/this[588] as 8.0/(range) scales.

Constructor-style initializer: writes alternating 0 and -1 literals into six DWORD fields at +0, +4, +8, +0xC, +0x10 and +0x14, delegates the backing array setup to LapSessionDataArrayInitializer (0x004C07F0), and returns the this pointer.

Career standings ini writer (__thiscall): writes a settings/standings block into the caller-owned buffer a2 as key-value pairs. Optionally resolves resource paths via ResourceLookupWithDualPath when a3 is nonzero. Writes Name/VehFile/RcdFile keys, then a per-entry loop over up to 48 finish entries at this+0x18 (negative-sentinel-terminated) emitting FinishPosition/FinishPoints pairs, followed by SeasonPoints/PointsPosition/PolesTaken/OriginalGridPos/CurrentGridPos/ControlType/Active keys and a trailing word_5C30B4 separator token. Called by PlayerOpponentStateWriter (0x004C0CC0).

classes.name: SessionDataObject
classes.responsibility: Session/game-data runtime object. Owns the loaded data file handle and load-state flag, three linked node lists (first/pool, second at 0x6C0, third at 0x714), the path/filename buffers, per-vehicle session-state and visibility arrays, the loading-phase and angle-clamp-mode bytes, the loading resource handle, and the session-time/delta fields. Its methods deserialize data files, load/reset them, walk replay entries, and drive the two-phase session loading sequence.

classes.name: RaceSessionObject
classes.responsibility: Race/session state object referenced cross-object by lap timing and data loading: exposes the session-finished phase flag and the vehicle data reference dword. No required function owns it in this packet; ownership stays UNKNOWN.

classes.name: SceneNodeWriter
classes.responsibility: Writes a model/scene node record: resolves a resource handle via ResourceLookupDispatcher into this+0x04 and emits the object through the file-write backend in two lengths (4 then 2 dword-bytes); always returns 1. Structurally a twin of FileHandleCloseRegistration (0x004B4470) per cluster copy (DERIVED).

classes.name: ReplayRecordingController
classes.responsibility: Controls replay recording: guards the session state and session type, creates the replay directory, builds the replay file path, starts a recorder SessionDataObject at this+0x08 via ThunkToFUN004b7300 (GameDataFileIO), drives and polls it, and otherwise renders a 'recording not available' message.

classes.name: SessionWeatherDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Type-sentinel two-path dispatcher: sentinel 1 routes to the session update path (operating on a SessionDataObject at this+0x08), sentinel 2 routes to the weather path; returns a char status from whichever path ran.

classes.name: LapTimingObject
classes.responsibility: Per-driver lap/sector timing state: records lap splits, best lap/best sector state, pit-stop order ranks, pending penalties, and finish/retirement flags; the LapCompletion method dispatches on session type to retire, penalize, disqualify, or finish a driver.

classes.name: SceneExtentObject
classes.responsibility: Computes normalized scene extents from the collision geometry bounding boxes: stores two axis minima and two 8.0/(max-min) scale values on itself (this[585]..this[588]); emits a debug log when no non-degenerate bounds are found.

classes.name: LapSessionDataObject
classes.responsibility: Constructor-style lap session data initializer: writes an alternating 0/-1 pattern into six leading DWORD fields and delegates the backing array setup to LapSessionDataArrayInitializer (0x004C07F0); returns the this pointer.

classes.name: SettingsIniWriterObject
classes.responsibility: Career standings ini writer: emits a key-value settings/standings block (Name/VehFile/RcdFile, per-entry FinishPosition/FinishPoints, season keys, trailing separator) into a caller-owned buffer; optionally resolves resource paths.

state_machines.name: SessionLoadingPhaseMachine
states: Phase1 (this+0xF80 == 1; per-vehicle effect tables initialized, session state transitioned to 3)
Phase2 (visibility/state propagation, clamp mode this+0xF81 == 0, resource handle this+0xF40 released to -1)
transitions: LoadingPhaseOrchestrator forces dword_7C569C to 1 and advances the game state machine via GameActionStateMachine (0x0040CDE0) to phase 5, then to the decoded phase; runs LoadingPhase1 then LoadingPhase2 and restores dword_7C569C.
Phase1 → Phase2: LoadingPhase1 sets this+0xF80 = 1 and transitions session state to 3 via SessionStateTransition (0x004EF5A0); clamp mode this+0xF81 = 1.
Phase2 sets this+0xF81 = 0 (wrap), re-runs StateTriggerCheck, cleans the session structure (dword_5EA560), releases this+0xF40, and returns 1.

state_machines.name: RaceSessionFinishedGate
transitions: LapCompletion early-returns when obj+0x32C8 == 3; penalty countdown only runs while obj+0x32C8 <= 1; the finish path sets this+0x30 = 1 and bumps the session mode via sub_42D140(&dword_7C569C, 8).
LoadingPhaseOrchestrator writes 1 then 2 into the caller out-parameter during loading.

state_machines.name: ReplayRecordingStateMachine
transitions: Start when the session-state check passes and (dword_7D0038 || dword_7D005C) and dword_7C56A4 == 7: sets *this = 1, creates the replay directory, builds the replay path, and starts the recorder via ThunkToFUN004b7300(this+0x08, path, 1).
On recorder start failure *this is cleared to 0.
State 2 sets the flag byte at (this[2] + 3968, i.e. recorder+0xF80) to 1.
When the start condition is not met, *this is forced to 0 and the 'recording not available' message path is taken (unless dword_7D0410 is 5 or 6).

state_machines.name: LapPenaltyCountdown
transitions: Per-frame decrement of the this+0x3C pending-penalty timers; on expiry, when the vehicle's penalty flag is not exempt, zero the slot and call DisqualificationHandler (0x004BC0E0) while the session is unfinished.
While any penalty remains, the countdown accumulates into this+0x84.

interfaces.name: IResourceHandleService
interfaces.purpose: Resolve, query, seek, close and dual-path resource handles and streams used by the data loader, replay reader and ini writer.

interfaces.name: IByteStreamDispatcher
interfaces.purpose: Chunked write/dispatch through the file backend and length-checked buffer writes used for model data, replay dispatch and ini text.

interfaces.name: IStringBufferOps
interfaces.purpose: Copy strings into reallocated buffers and truncate/parse path buffers.

interfaces.name: ISessionStateMachine
interfaces.purpose: Decode and advance the session phase, transition session states, and check session state.

interfaces.name: IStringTableLookup
interfaces.purpose: Binary-search string tables and render text messages to the player.

interfaces.name: IMemoryAllocator
interfaces.purpose: Allocation/free wrappers for the list nodes built during deserialization.

compatibility_contracts.name: LoadedDataHandleGuard
compatibility_contracts.description: Data-loading entry points report readiness by returning *(this+0x6E4) != 0; a nonzero loaded-data handle at this+0x6E4 means a data file is loaded.

compatibility_contracts.name: LoadStateFlagEnum
compatibility_contracts.description: this+0x700 encodes the data load state: 0 = settings file not found, 1 = settings file found, 2 = model/scene loaded.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionTypeDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: Global dword_7C56A4 is the session-type selector: value 7 enables replay recording (with dword_7D0038/dword_7D005C), and in LapCompletion it selects retirement/penalty/finish/last-lap handling via the jump table at 0x004BC984.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleArrayAccess
compatibility_contracts.description: The current vehicle is dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54E4] and the vehicle count is dword_5C329C. Vehicle field +0x4894 (18580 bytes) is mirrored into SessionDataObject+0xF1C on reset, per-vehicle state byte +0x105D (4189) is mirrored through the this+0x93C visibility array, and vehicle effect tables live at +0x32C8/+13000 (initialized via 0x004E1970, driven via 0x004E19A0).

compatibility_contracts.name: BackslashDirectorySeparator
compatibility_contracts.description: Directory extraction scans the path globals dword_7CE5D0 / dword_7CE608 for the last byte 0x5C (92) and advances one byte past it; each falls back to byte_5EA438 when null.

compatibility_contracts.name: SettingsIniKeySchema
compatibility_contracts.description: The career standings ini block writes keys Name/VehFile/RcdFile, per-entry FinishPosition/FinishPoints (up to 48 entries, negative sentinel at this+0x18), then SeasonPoints/PointsPosition/PolesTaken/OriginalGridPos/CurrentGridPos/ControlType/Active and a trailing separator token at word_5C30B4.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionFinishedPhase
compatibility_contracts.description: RaceSessionObject+0x32C8 value 3 marks the session finished and short-circuits LapCompletion; penalty countdown processing requires 0x32C8 <= 1.

compatibility_contracts.name: ReplayFileNaming
compatibility_contracts.description: Replay path is assembled from the track name (TrackNameReader 0x004C5920, looked up in byte_5EC4C0/byte_5EC4CC), truncated at the asc_5D251C delimiter by sub_587C20, appended with the replay file name from the global at 0x005BE714, in a directory created via CreateDirectoryAWrapper.
